product: Priorix (Measles, Mumps, and Rubella Vaccine, Live) - US approval 2022

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
PRIORIX contains the Schwarz strain of live attenuated measles virus, the RIT 4385 strain of live attenuated
mumps virus (derived from the Jeryl Lynn strain), both propagated in chick-embryo fibroblasts from
embryonated eggs of specific pathogen-free flocks and the Wistar RA 27/3 strain of live attenuated rubella virus
propagated in MRC-5 human diploid cells.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each dose may also contain residual amounts of neomycin sulphate (≤25 mcg), ovalbumin (≤60 ng),
and bovine serum albumin (≤50 ng), from the manufacturing process.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
The stopper of the vial containing Lyophilized Antigen Component, Live and the tip cap and rubber plunger
stopper of the prefilled syringe containing Sterile Water Diluent Component are not made with natural rubber
latex.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Do not administer PRIORIX to individuals with a history of severe allergic reactions (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any
component of the vaccine or after a previous dose of any measles, mumps, and rubella virus-containing vaccine
[see Description (11)].
